title: 2012 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: Cagney can frost a cupcake every \(20\) seconds and Lacey can frost a cupcake every \(30\) seconds. Working together, how many cupcakes can they frost in \(5\) minutes?

solutions.text:
Cagney can make \(60 \div 20 = 3\) cupcakes per minute, and Lacey can make \(60 \div 30 = 2.\)

In \(5\) minutes, they can make \[ 5(2 + 3) = 5 \cdot 5 = 25. \]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Convert each frosting rate to cupcakes per minute
Add the two rates, then multiply by \(5\) minutes
